info.name: FlipStar Backend API - Staging
info.description:
Staging copy of the generated FlipStar collection, pre-pointed at https://api.uat.flipstar.et so no Postman environment is needed.

Auth: DRF Token, not Bearer -- 'Authorization: Token <key>'. Run any login/register request and its test script captures {{token}} for the rest of the collection.

TLS: staging currently serves a self-signed certificate. Turn OFF Settings > General > SSL certificate verification, or requests fail before they leave Postman.

Twenty endpoints (auth, wallet, direct-debit, charging) require end-to-end encrypted bodies and will return 400 'Missing required X-Client-Public-Key header' from Postman. That is correct behaviour, not a broken request -- see docs/encrypted_transport.md.

Trailing slashes are mandatory; Django's APPEND_SLASH cannot redirect a POST without discarding the body.
